Variants.Content: The free city-states are not the same kind of country: Braavos prides itself on anti-slavery, finance, and sea kings, Volantis advocates the old blood and slave order, Pentos is balanced by wealthy merchants and princes, and Myr, Tyrosh, and Lys each compete with crafts, ports, and sea routes. theirThe common denominator is that cities, trade, mercenaries, debt, and cross-sea networks are more powerful than feudal villages. A man may rise by craft, money, ships, or debts, or fall by debts, wars, servitude, and factions. The "freedom" of a free city-state never automatically belongs to everyone, but it is always the language used by merchants and rulers to negotiate.
